summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, disclosing its total voting rights and share capital as of June 30, 2026. The filing states there were 601,140,494 ordinary shares of 25p each admitted to trading, each carrying one vote, and no shares held in Treasury. This routine disclosure is made under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1 to enable shareholders to determine notifiable interests. No material corporate event, transaction, or board action is announced; it is a standard regulatory compliance filing.
